levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Deck is 4:3, all eight slides are in order, and every station slide carries the part photo, the drawing (or the xTool screenshot on slide 6), a notebook line naming something specific, and a process decision.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All eight slides present, with one required element missing from one station slide, or the deck is not 4:3.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Six or seven slides, or a required element missing from two or more station slides.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Fewer than six slides, or no deck submitted.

criterion: Slide by slide: Slide structure and content

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Every image is the student's own photo or screenshot, every part is identifiable in its photo, no slide except the title exceeds 35 words, and every slide except the title carries an image filling at least a third of it.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One image is unusable, generated, or sourced elsewhere, or one slide exceeds 35 words, or one slide is missing its image.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Two or three images or slides fail on those grounds.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Four or more images or slides fail on those grounds, or the deck relies on generated or stock images.

criterion: Your images: Image quality and density

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Slide 7 shows nominal, measured and signed difference for all five parts, and the conclusion names both processes, a reason from the four, and one of their own numbers.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Slide 7 is complete and the conclusion names both processes and a reason, without citing a measured number.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Slide 7 is missing values or parts, or the conclusion names one process only, or gives no reason from the four.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No conclusion written or no measurement data. A link that does not open scores zero here and on the other two deck criteria.

criterion: Your numbers and your conclusion: Numbers and conclusion

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: States a process decision at all five stations, each naming a tool, setting, workholding, or sequence choice and what it was chosen over. Naming the machine or the operation alone does not count.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: States a qualifying choice at all five stations without naming what it was chosen over, or names choice and alternative at four.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: States a qualifying decision at two or three stations.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: States a qualifying decision at one station or none.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Names the closest and furthest process using their own largest differences, gives a reason from the four listed, ties that reason to one of their measured numbers, and ranks all five processes closest to furthest.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names both processes from their own numbers and gives a reason from the four listed, but either does not tie it to a measured value or does not rank all five.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Reads measurements aloud without naming which process was closest and furthest, or names them with no reason from the four.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Does not refer to their own measurements.

criterion: Present your portfolio: Data connected to process

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Answers both questions with a specific detail of their own setup, tooling, or measurement that is not written on a slide.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Answers one question from their own work and answers the other by repeating slide content.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Answers both questions by repeating slide content, or answers one and cannot answer the other.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Answers neither question, or does not present.
